recipe.visualDefinition: A high-angle, over-the-shoulder perspective of a person in a white garment holding a medical clipboard against a dark wood-paneled wall. The clipboard features a fever chart with a rising red line, overlaid with bold red text. The main title is positioned at the top in a contrasting bright yellow with a red outline.
coreVisualRelationships: The rising red line on the chart mimics the upward energy of the central red text.
The warm wood background provides a dark, textured contrast to the bright white paper and shirt.
The person's hands frame the clipboard, drawing the eye to the center of the composition.
The yellow title at the top balances the visual weight of the white shirt at the bottom.
coreInvariants: Vertical wood grain texture in the background
Over-the-shoulder framing showing the side of a face and hands
A grid-based medical chart with a sharp upward trajectory line
High-contrast primary color palette (Red, Yellow, White) against brown

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The clipboard is the central focus, held at a slight angle by a figure whose back and profile occupy the right and bottom-left foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The clipboard's metal clip and the bold red text in the center of the grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the yellow title, moves down to the clipboard, follows the rising red line on the chart, and rests on the central red text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The wood paneling in the upper-right and left provides breathing room for the text and subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm brown (wood paneling) and off-white (shirt and paper).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright red for the chart line and central text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant yellow with red outlines for the primary header.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the typography against the muted, natural tones of the photographic background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' in the header has a short, squared hook.
The 'R' has a straight diagonal leg.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform sans-serif family with varying weights and colors to distinguish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, blocky feel of the display text.
Provides a similar mid-century industrial sans-serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1950s style color photograph from an over-the-shoulder perspective. A person in a white lab coat or shirt holds a vintage clipboard with a medical fever chart. The chart has a black grid and a red line spiking upwards. The background is dark vertical wood paneling. Warm, directional lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed uppercase sans-serif text at the top in bright yellow with a thin red outline. Add a second set of bold red uppercase sans-serif text centered on the clipboard, tilted slightly to match the angle of the paper.

verificationChecks: Is the wood paneling visible and textured?
Does the chart line spike upward significantly?
Is the top text yellow with a red outline?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the red chart line
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos in the corners
Exact numerical values on the chart axes
Specific facial features of the model

mustAchieve: Authentic 1950s film grain and color saturation
Realistic interaction between hands and clipboard

postGenerationChecks: Text is perfectly centered or intentionally angled
Colors are vibrant but consistent with vintage print
The 'fever' theme is visually communicated through the chart and text
The wood texture feels tactile and deep
recipe.reuseFormula: Over-the-shoulder prop interaction + Mid-century wood paneling + Bold primary-color condensed sans-serif typography.
